text: I. Core Positioning of the DisciplineChemistry focuses on the essence and transformation of substances as its core research object. Through the combination of experiments and theory, it reveals the existence forms (such as molecules, atoms, ions) of substances, their internal structures (such as chemical bonds, crystal structures), physical and chemical properties (such as melting point, reactivity), as well as the change patterns that occur under certain conditions (such as decomposition, synthesis, and transformation). It is not only the foundation for understanding nature but also a key tool for creating new substances and solving problems related to energy, environment, and health faced by humanity.II. Training ObjectivesTo cultivate high-quality talents with solid chemical knowledge, experimental skills, and scientific thinking, who can engage in scientific research, teaching, technology development, product testing, management, etc. in the field of chemistry and related areas. Core competencies include: Master the core theories of inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, analytical chemistry, and physical chemistry;Proficiently use various chemical experimental instruments (such as spectrometers, chromatographs, mass spectrometers), and possess the ability to design and operate experiments, as well as analyze data;Understand the latest developments in the field of chemistry, have preliminary scientific research and innovation capabilities, and be able to apply chemical principles to solve practical problems.
